conflicts.permit: We may disclose Personal Data to our third party service providers to provide you with the Services, including our third party payment processor.
conflicts.prohibit: We do not sell, rent, or otherwise share your data to any third-party for a business or commercial purpose, other than the Auction House.
conflicts.situation: Sharing user data with third-party service providers (such as payment processors) for business purposes.
conflicts.reason: The prohibition explicitly bars sharing data with any third party other than the Auction House, yet the policy authorizes sharing Personal Data with third-party service providers.
